title: 塞布尔菲尔德目标状态系统设计
instruction:
您是负责 Sablefield Tire & Auto 七个服务中心的总经理和运营经理。我们的运营副总裁 Lachlan Zamora 需要一个目标状态系统设计，他可以在 Peoria 后台服务器于 11 月停止支持之前将其提供给合同集成商和为设备租赁融资的银行。当前环境在皮奥里亚有一台 Windows Server 2012 R2 机器，支持预订、零件查找以及与 Longbarrow Components 经销商价格反馈的连接；商店还使用必须与车间网络分开的卡终端。当客户在柜台时，零件查找必须快速答复，分销商源仍然只与旧服务器通信，并且更换必须保持在$4,500的每月总租赁和服务上限内。温德米尔议会是车队客户之一，其预订和付款记录必须继续在各中心进行一致处理。准备一个承诺的目标状态系统设计，而不是一系列替代方案，并解释为什么可靠的替代方案被拒绝。标记系统设计和属于金融、信息安全、支付处理器或集成商的工作之间的界限；不要将批准、安全认证或实施工作作为已完成的事实来呈现。
该包必须包含`target_state_design_memo.docx`，Lachlan 的决策备忘录，其中包含执行摘要、当前状态约束、目标状态设计、假设和风险、拒绝的配置、所有权边界和可供决策的结论； `target_state_architecture.pdf`，单页架构图，显示所有七个中心、皮奥里亚、遗留提要依赖性、预订、零件查找、卡处理、网络边界以及相关故障或切换点； `decision_trace.xlsx`，一个简明的比较和可追溯性登记册，将每种材料要求与选定的设计、拒绝的配置、成本处理以及备忘录或图表位置联系起来。使用这些文件名将所有三个文件放在工作目录的顶层。将备忘录控制在四页或更少，将图表控制在一页，并且使工作簿足够简洁，以便管理人员无需演练即可进行审核。在三个文件中使用一致的术语、配置名称、成本数字和结论，区分已知事实和假设，并且不要在 11 月支持截止日期之后编造供应商报价、银行批准、安全证明或实施日期。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `target_state_design_memo.docx` — 一份决策备忘录，描述一种目标状态系统设计以及所选和拒绝配置背后的推理。 （最多四页。；必须可供高级决策者和合同集成商使用。；必须区分事实、假设、风险、所有权边界和未解决的批准。；必须使用与架构 PDF 和决策工作簿一致的术语和数字。）
- `target_state_architecture.pdf` — 一页目标状态架构图，显示站点、服务、依赖项、网络分离以及故障或切换点。 （恰好一页。；以正常页面大小打印或查看时必须清晰。；必须与备忘录和工作簿中所选的设计、名称、边界和依赖关系一致。）
- `decision_trace.xlsx` — 简洁的审核登记册，将所选设计与可信的拒绝配置进行比较，并跟踪要求、成本、假设和文档位置。 （必须简洁且可在没有演练的情况下进行执行审核。；必须根据$4,500上限显示每月租赁和服务处理。；必须使用与备忘录和图表相同的配置名称、结论和材料数据。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: 值与公式提取，不还原原始排版；每表最多120行、30列。

sheets.name: Decision trace
rows: Selected configuration: Managed Operations Hub with Peoria Edge Relay
Move supported workloads to hosted hub; Peoria edge relay replaces 2012 R2 role before November.
Single hosted booking service, one synchronized tenant over managed WAN.
Seven site servers — consistency and support burden.
Read-only cache served from hub; fast local WAN path; cache age visible.
Cloud-only direct feed — no proven legacy protocol.
Integrator tests latency and cache behavior
Peoria edge relay polls legacy-only feed and publishes validated cache.
Cloud-only direct integration — unpriced compatibility risk.
Terminals on dedicated payment VLAN/processor path outside shop-floor network.
Flat shared LAN — violates stated separation.
Included in WAN planning; processor fees excluded
Per-site servers — likely exceeds ceiling; quote required.
Finance validates terms, taxes, bank package
WAN queues bookings; feed outage uses labeled last-known-good cache; payment issues go to processor procedure.
No-cache design — counter lookup stops with feed outage.
Same hosted booking/payment record path across centers; payment data remains processor-owned.
Operations + finance reconcile; processor boundary open
Cost assumptions are planning values, not vendor quotations or approvals.

gold.text:
DECISION MEMORANDUM
Sablefield Tire & Auto | Target-state systems design
To
Lachlan Zamora, VP of Operations
From
General & Operations Manager
Decision
Authorize the target design for integrator scoping and finance review
Trigger
Peoria Windows Server 2012 R2 leaves support in November

Executive summary
Approve one target state: Managed Operations Hub with Peoria Edge Relay. A hosted booking and parts-lookup service serves all seven centers; a small managed edge VM remains in Peoria solely for the Longbarrow Components legacy price-feed connector and a synchronized parts-price cache. Card terminals use a separate payment VLAN/processor path and never join the shop-floor network. The planning recurring estimate is $4,100/month, $400 below the $4,500 ceiling. This is an operations design decision, not evidence of bank, security, processor, or integrator approval.
Current-state constraints (known facts)
• Seven service centers depend on a Peoria back-office Windows Server 2012 R2 machine for booking, parts lookup, and the Longbarrow Components distributor feed.
• The server reaches end of support in November.
• Counter staff need fast parts answers; the distributor feed still communicates only with the legacy server.
• Card terminals must remain separate from the shop-floor network. Windermere Council fleet bookings and payment records must continue consistently across centers.
Target-state design — one committed configuration
The Managed Operations Hub with Peoria Edge Relay has four layers:
Layer / placement
Decision treatment
Continuity / handoff
Hosted operations hub
Booking and parts-lookup application; one tenant for all seven centers, reachable over managed WAN.
Each center has local browser/workstation access; booking queues locally during a short WAN interruption and staff escalate unresolved items.
Peoria edge relay
Managed VM replaces the unsupported server role for the Longbarrow connector. It pulls the feed, validates timestamps, and publishes a read-only price cache to the hub.
If feed is down, last-known-good prices are labeled with age; parts lookup remains available. Feed/vendor issue is handed to integrator/Longbarrow.
Payment boundary
Card terminals and payment gateway sit on a dedicated payment VLAN/Internet path, outside the shop-floor VLAN and hub trust zone.
Payment authorization failure is handled by processor procedure; no card data is written to booking or shop-floor systems.
Recurring cost treatment (planning estimate)
Component (assumption pending quote)
$/month
Hosted booking + parts lookup service
$1,650
Peoria edge VM, backup and monitoring
$850
WAN/connectivity for seven centers
$980
Managed support and feed operations
$620
Total / ceiling headroom
$4,100 / $4,500 ($400 headroom)
All figures are internal planning assumptions, not vendor quotations or lease terms. Finance must validate lease structure, taxes, term, and bank documentation before commitment.
Assumptions and risks
ASSUMPTIONS: existing counter workstations and card terminals can use the managed WAN; the Longbarrow connector can run in a supported VM wrapper; the price feed permits scheduled polling; ${980:,.0f}/month covers connectivity at all seven centers. RISKS: feed protocol or licensing may require a connector change; WAN outage affects live booking; cache age can make a price stale; actual quotes could exceed the ceiling. Integrator must test connector, failover, and cache labeling before cutover; operations will not claim completion until evidence is supplied.
Rejected configurations
1) Cloud-only hub with direct Longbarrow integration — rejected because the stated feed is legacy-server-only; assuming a cloud-compatible protocol would create an unpriced dependency and jeopardize counter service.
2) Seven independent site servers — rejected because it multiplies support, backup, and data-consistency risk for Windermere Council bookings and would erode the ${4500:,.0f}/month ceiling.
3) Retain and virtualize the 2012 R2 server — rejected because it preserves the November support exposure and leaves a single Peoria failure domain.
Ownership boundaries and decision
Operations owns this placement decision, service priorities, and acceptance criteria. Finance owns lease affordability, term, taxes, and bank package approval. Information Security owns segmentation review, access controls, logging, and any certification. The payment processor owns terminal/gateway certification and outage procedures. The contract integrator owns sizing, migration, connector testing, backup restore tests, and implementation dates. None of those approvals or activities is represented as complete here.
DECISION REQUEST: Lachlan should authorize Managed Operations Hub with Peoria Edge Relay as the sole target-state brief for integrator scoping and finance/security/processor review before the November deadline. Do not authorize production cutover until the named owners accept their evidence.

criteria.description: 该包将 11 月支持截止日期和 Peoria 旧服务器确定为启动约束。
criteria.evidence: 备忘录当前状态或执行部分；工作簿需求跟踪。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认截止日期和 Peoria 旧服务器依赖性都是明确的，而不仅仅是暗示的。

original.criterion: The package identifies the November support deadline and the Peoria legacy server as the initiating constraint.
original.evidence: Memo current-state or executive section; workbook requirement trace.
original.grader_hint: Confirm both the deadline and Peoria legacy-server dependency are explicit, not merely implied.

criteria.description: 该备忘录致力于一种一致的目标状态配置，而不是提出几种同等的选项。
criteria.evidence: 备忘录结论和目标状态部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较可能包含替代方案，但只能将一种配置识别为目标状态。

original.criterion: The memo commits to exactly one coherent target-state configuration rather than presenting several co-equal options.
original.evidence: Memo conclusion and target-state section.
original.grader_hint: A comparison may contain alternatives, but only one configuration may be identified as the target state.

criteria.description: 选定的设计为所有七个服务中心的预订提供了连贯的主页和连续性路径。
criteria.evidence: 备忘录和架构图。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查设计是否命名了预订服务位置或托管边界，并解释了每个中心如何到达它。

original.criterion: The selected design provides a coherent home and continuity path for booking across all seven service centers.
original.evidence: Memo and architecture diagram.
original.grader_hint: Check that the design names the booking service location or hosting boundary and explains how each center reaches it.

criteria.description: 所选设计支持在柜台及时查找零件，同时解决传统的 Longbarrow Components 价格反馈依赖性。
criteria.evidence: 目标状态叙述、依赖箭头和跟踪寄存器。
criteria.grader_hint: 证据必须涵盖反反应性和饲料的合理处理；仅提及一项是不够的。

original.criterion: The selected design supports timely parts lookup at the counter while addressing the legacy-only Longbarrow Components price-feed dependency.
original.evidence: Target-state narrative, dependency arrows, and trace register.
original.grader_hint: The evidence must cover both counter responsiveness and a defensible treatment of the feed; mentioning only one is insufficient.

criteria.description: 卡处理保持在车间网络之外，相关边界和交接变得易于理解。
criteria.evidence: 架构图和备忘录网络边界描述。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明显的分离和支付信息如何流动的解释，而不将卡处理放在车间网络上。

original.criterion: Card handling is kept outside the shop-floor network, with the relevant boundary and handoff made understandable.
original.evidence: Architecture diagram and memo network-boundary description.
original.grader_hint: Look for a visible separation and an explanation of how payment information flows without placing card handling on the shop-floor network.

criteria.description: 该设计解释了当所需服务或连接不可用时会发生什么，包括操作影响和切换。
criteria.evidence: 图表故障或切换点；备忘风险和运营假设。
criteria.grader_hint: 至少一种有意义的预订、零件/进给访问或付款故障模式必须具有可理解的响应或升级边界。

original.criterion: The design explains what happens when a required service or connection is unavailable, including the operational impact and handoff.
original.evidence: Diagram failure or handoff points; memo risks and operating assumptions.
original.grader_hint: At least one meaningful failure mode for booking, parts/feed access, or payment must have an intelligible response or escalation boundary.

criteria.description: 所选设计的规定经常性租赁和服务成本每月不超过$4,500，计算或处理可见。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿成本比较和备忘录财务部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算规定的重复成分；接受其组成部分 ±$1 范围内的总计，并要求总计等于或低于$4,500。

original.criterion: The selected design's stated recurring lease and service cost is no more than $4,500 per month, with the arithmetic or treatment visible.
original.evidence: Workbook cost comparison and memo financial section.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate the stated recurring components; accept totals within ±$1 of their components and require the total to be at or below $4,500.

criteria.description: 该比较包括至少两个可信的被拒绝的配置，并给出拒绝每个配置的独特的运营或财务原因。
criteria.evidence: 备忘录替代部分和工作簿比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 不要只为标签颁奖；每个被拒绝的选项都需要有一个与规定的限制相关的理由。

original.criterion: The comparison includes at least two credible rejected configurations and gives a distinct operational or financial reason for rejecting each.
original.evidence: Memo alternatives section and workbook comparison.
original.grader_hint: Do not award for labels alone; each rejected option needs a reason tied to the stated constraints.

criteria.description: 所选配置可追溯到已安装或现有的硬件和依赖项，而不是仅作为首选项来证明其合理性。
criteria.evidence: 备注当前状态到目标的跟踪和工作簿寄存器。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找到 Peoria 服务器、商店设备、卡终端或传统经销商连接的明确链接。

original.criterion: The selected configuration is traced back to installed or existing hardware and dependencies rather than being justified only as a preference.
original.evidence: Memo current-state-to-target trace and workbook register.
original.grader_hint: Look for explicit links to the Peoria server, store equipment, card terminals, or the legacy distributor connection.

criteria.description: 该备忘录明确地将运营的设计决策与财务、信息安全、支付处理商和集成商的职责分开。
criteria.evidence: 备忘录所有权边界部分和工作簿所有权列。
criteria.grader_hint: 边界必须确定作者权限之外的责任或批准。

original.criterion: The memo clearly separates operations' design decision from finance, information security, payment-processor, and integrator responsibilities.
original.evidence: Memo ownership-boundary section and workbook ownership column.
original.grader_hint: The boundary must identify responsibilities or approvals that remain outside the author's authority.

criteria.description: 该包将已知事实与假设区分开来，并识别可能改变设计或成本的重大风险或依赖性。
criteria.evidence: 备注假设和风险；工作簿假设或警告。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当假设被明显标记并与结果、验证或决策限制相关联时才授予奖励。

original.criterion: The package distinguishes known facts from assumptions and identifies material risks or dependencies that could change the design or cost.
original.evidence: Memo assumptions and risks; workbook assumptions or caveats.
original.grader_hint: Award only when assumptions are visibly labeled and connected to a consequence, validation, or decision limitation.

criteria.description: 该架构图包括所有七个服务中心和一个可识别的皮奥里亚位置或服务器边界。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的 PDF。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算所表示的中心并验证 Peoria 没有隐藏为未标记的通用节点。

original.criterion: The architecture diagram includes all seven service centers and a recognizable Peoria location or server boundary.
original.evidence: Rendered PDF.
original.grader_hint: Count the represented centers and verify Peoria is not hidden as an unlabeled generic node.

criteria.description: 该图明显区分了车间网络和卡片处理路径，并标记了 Longbarrow feed 依赖性。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的 PDF。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查视觉边界、标签和箭头；图表之外的纯散文注释不满足本项要求。

original.criterion: The diagram visibly distinguishes the shop-floor network from the card-handling path and labels the Longbarrow feed dependency.
original.evidence: Rendered PDF.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the visual boundary, labels, and arrows; a prose-only note outside the diagram does not satisfy this item.

criteria.description: 决策工作簿跟踪每项主要要求（预订、对应零件查找、分销商反馈、付款分离、支持期限和每月上限）到设计处理和文档位置。
criteria.evidence: 渲染或检查的工作簿。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个指定的需求是否都有处理方法和指向备忘录或图表的可用指针，而不仅仅是重复的需求短语。

original.criterion: The decision workbook traces each major requirement—booking, counter parts lookup, distributor feed, payment separation, support deadline, and monthly ceiling—to a design treatment and document location.
original.evidence: Rendered or inspected workbook.
original.grader_hint: Check that every named requirement has a treatment and a usable pointer to the memo or diagram, not just a repeated requirement phrase.

criteria.description: 工作簿的选择/拒绝状态和理由与备忘录的替代方案讨论一致。
criteria.evidence: 作业本和备忘录。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较配置名称、状态和拒绝理由；如果映射明确，则等效措辞是可以接受的。

original.criterion: The workbook's selected/rejected status and rationale agree with the memo's alternatives discussion.
original.evidence: Workbook and memo.
original.grader_hint: Compare configuration names, status, and rejection rationale; equivalent wording is acceptable if the mapping is unambiguous.

criteria.description: 配置名称、经常性成本、选定的结论和主要系统布局在所有三个可交付成果中均一致。
criteria.evidence: 备忘录、PDF 和 XLSX。
criteria.grader_hint: 审核文件中的相同事实；与矛盾文件的部分协议不应获得认可。

original.criterion: The configuration name, recurring cost, selected conclusion, and major system placements agree across all three deliverables.
original.evidence: Memo, PDF, and XLSX.
original.grader_hint: Audit the same facts across files; partial agreement with a contradictory file should not receive credit.

criteria.description: 备忘录不超过四页，架构 PDF 正好一页。
criteria.evidence: 文件内省和渲染页数。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用文档和 PDF 页数；不要从可见文本推断页数。

original.criterion: The memo is no more than four pages and the architecture PDF is exactly one page.
original.evidence: File introspection and rendered page count.
original.grader_hint: Use document and PDF page counts; do not infer page count from visible text.

criteria.description: 所有三个必需的文件都存在于顶层，具有确切的请求文件名和可读格式。
criteria.evidence: 工作目录列表和文件打开/渲染测试。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证准确的拼写、扩展名和顶级位置。

original.criterion: All three required files exist at the top level with the exact requested filenames and readable formats.
original.evidence: Working-directory listing and file open/render test.
original.grader_hint: Verify exact spelling, extension, and top-level placement.

criteria.description: 高级决策者可以了解单一设计、其权衡、财务边界和未解决的所有权问题，而无需要求作者进行演练。
criteria.evidence: 整个提交的包。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断层次结构、通俗易懂的语言解释、导航性以及文档是否支持决策而不仅仅是编目技术。

original.criterion: A senior decision maker can understand the single design, its trade-offs, financial boundary, and unresolved ownership questions without asking the author for a walkthrough.
original.evidence: Whole submitted package.
original.grader_hint: Judge hierarchy, plain-language explanation, navigability, and whether the documents support a decision rather than merely cataloging technology.

criteria.description: 该软件包相当谨慎：它不提供已批准或完成的集成商工作、银行融资、支付合规性或安全认证。
criteria.evidence: 整个提交的包。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的依赖性和批准资格；没有支持的确定性应该失去这个信用。

original.criterion: The package is appropriately cautious: it does not present integrator work, bank financing, payment compliance, or security certification as already approved or completed.
original.evidence: Whole submitted package.
original.grader_hint: Look for clear qualification of dependencies and approvals; unsupported certainty should lose this credit.

criteria.description: 结论通过一种合理的设计选择解决了即时柜台服务、仅传统的价格供给、支付隔离和租赁上限之间的冲突。
criteria.evidence: 备忘录结论、架构和工作簿基本原理。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要针对边缘情况进行明确的权衡或边界决策；关于将满足所有要求的一般性声明是不够的。

original.criterion: The conclusion resolves the collision between immediate counter service, the legacy-only price feed, payment isolation, and the lease ceiling in one defensible design choice.
original.evidence: Memo conclusion, architecture, and workbook rationale.
original.grader_hint: Require an explicit trade-off or boundary decision for the edge case; generic statements that all requirements will be met are insufficient.

spec.professional_context: This is an operations-manager decision package for replacing an unsupported multi-site back-office dependency while preserving store service, distributor integration, and payment-network separation. The documents must be decision-ready without overstating what finance, security, the payment processor, or an integrator has approved.
difficulty_sources: Selecting one defensible target state from several plausible configurations without supplied technical references
Reconciling counter-service responsiveness, a legacy-only distributor feed, payment-network separation, and a recurring lease ceiling
Marking operations' authority boundary without making unsupported claims about finance, security, the payment processor, or the integrator
Maintaining exact agreement across a memo, a one-page architecture diagram, and an audit workbook

authoring_plan.purpose: Construct a realistic gold package for a normative target-state systems design without supplying the solver with a hidden answer.

facts_and_constraints.organisation: Sablefield Tire & Auto operates seven service centers.
facts_and_constraints.legacy_dependency: A Peoria back-office Windows Server 2012 R2 machine currently supports booking, parts lookup, and the Longbarrow Components price-feed connection and reaches end of support in November.
operational_requirements: Parts lookup must remain usable at a customer-facing counter.
The distributor price feed remains a dependency that cannot simply be assumed to be cloud-compatible.
Card handling must remain outside the shop-floor network.
Recurring lease and service cost must be at or below $4,500 per month.
named_context: Lachlan Zamora is the VP of Operations and decision recipient.
Windermere Council is a fleet customer whose booking and payment continuity should be considered.
Longbarrow Components is the distributor connected through the legacy feed.

gold_design_requirements: Choose one target configuration and give it a memorable, consistent name across the memo, diagram, and workbook.
Include a plausible current-state inventory and explicitly mark any assumed hardware or pricing as assumptions.
Provide at least two credible alternatives that could satisfy portions of the brief but fail or become weaker under the combined constraints.
Show where booking, parts lookup, the legacy distributor connection, and card handling live, and show the network or trust boundary between shop-floor and payment paths.
Include a simple outage or handoff treatment for a material dependency.
Keep operations' decision boundary separate from finance approval, security/compliance validation, payment-processor certification, and integrator execution.
Use a recurring cost model whose components sum to a total no greater than $4,500 per month; use the same values everywhere.
Make the conclusion one committed design rather than a list of next steps or an unresolved menu.
Ensure the one-page diagram visibly represents seven centers and Peoria, with dependency arrows and labels.
Make the workbook a requirement-to-treatment and alternative-comparison register with document-location pointers.
quality_checks: Render the DOCX and PDF and verify the page limits.
Open the XLSX with a standard office library and verify formulas or stated arithmetic.
Cross-check configuration name, selected status, service placement, cost, and rationale across all deliverables.
Confirm the gold does not claim that approvals, certifications, quotations, or implementation have already occurred.

deliverables.description: A decision memorandum describing one target-state systems design and the reasoning behind the selected and rejected configurations.
constraints: Must be usable by a senior decision maker and a contract integrator.
Must distinguish facts, assumptions, risks, ownership boundaries, and unresolved approvals.
Must use terminology and figures consistent with the architecture PDF and decision workbook.

deliverables.description: A one-page target-state architecture diagram showing sites, services, dependencies, network separation, and failure or handoff points.
constraints: Must be legible when printed or viewed at normal page size.
Must agree with the selected design, names, boundaries, and dependencies in the memo and workbook.

deliverables.description: A concise audit register comparing the selected design with credible rejected configurations and tracing requirements, costs, assumptions, and document locations.
constraints: Must be concise and executive-auditable without a walkthrough.
Must show the monthly lease and service treatment against the $4,500 ceiling.
Must use the same configuration names, conclusions, and material figures as the memo and diagram.

original_instruction:
You are the general and operations manager responsible for Sablefield Tire & Auto’s seven service centers. Lachlan Zamora, our VP of Operations, needs a target-state systems design that he can give to a contract integrator and to the bank financing the equipment lease before the Peoria back-office server leaves support in November. The current environment has a Windows Server 2012 R2 machine in Peoria that supports booking, parts lookup, and the connection to Longbarrow Components’ distributor price feed; the stores also use card terminals that must remain separate from the shop-floor network. Parts lookup has to answer quickly while a customer is at the counter, the distributor feed still only communicates with the legacy server, and the replacement must stay within a total monthly lease and service ceiling of $4,500. Windermere Council is one of the fleet customers whose bookings and payment records must continue to be handled consistently across the centers. Prepare one committed target-state systems design, not a menu of alternatives, and explain why the credible alternatives were rejected. Mark the boundary between the systems design and work that belongs to finance, information security, the payment processor, or the integrator; do not present approvals, security certification, or implementation work as completed facts. The package must contain `target_state_design_memo.docx`, a decision memorandum for Lachlan with an executive summary, current-state constraints, target-state design, assumptions and risks, rejected configurations, ownership boundaries, and a decision-ready conclusion; `target_state_architecture.pdf`, a single-page architecture diagram showing all seven centers, Peoria, the legacy feed dependency, booking, parts lookup, card handling, network boundaries, and relevant failure or handoff points; and `decision_trace.xlsx`, a concise comparison and traceability register linking each material requirement to the selected design, rejected configurations, cost treatment, and the memo or diagram location. Put all three files at the top level of the working directory using exactly those filenames. Keep the memo to four pages or fewer, the diagram to one page, and the workbook concise enough for an executive to audit without a walkthrough. Use consistent terminology, configuration names, cost figures, and conclusions across the three files, distinguish known facts from assumptions, and do not invent vendor quotations, bank approvals, security attestations, or implementation dates beyond the November support deadline.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `target_state_design_memo.docx` — A decision memorandum describing one target-state systems design and the reasoning behind the selected and rejected configurations. (Maximum four pages.; Must be usable by a senior decision maker and a contract integrator.; Must distinguish facts, assumptions, risks, ownership boundaries, and unresolved approvals.; Must use terminology and figures consistent with the architecture PDF and decision workbook.)
- `target_state_architecture.pdf` — A one-page target-state architecture diagram showing sites, services, dependencies, network separation, and failure or handoff points. (Exactly one page.; Must be legible when printed or viewed at normal page size.; Must agree with the selected design, names, boundaries, and dependencies in the memo and workbook.)
- `decision_trace.xlsx` — A concise audit register comparing the selected design with credible rejected configurations and tracing requirements, costs, assumptions, and document locations. (Must be concise and executive-auditable without a walkthrough.; Must show the monthly lease and service treatment against the $4,500 ceiling.; Must use the same configuration names, conclusions, and material figures as the memo and diagram.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
